Class RmiClientHandler

java.lang.Object
java.rmi.server.RemoteObject
java.rmi.server.RemoteServer
java.rmi.server.UnicastRemoteObject
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckers.network.server.rmi.RmiClientHandler
All Implemented Interfaces:
ClientHandler, RemoteController, VirtualClient, Serializable, Remote
public class RmiClientHandler extends UnicastRemoteObject implements RemoteController, ClientHandler
Handles communication with a client over RMI. It processes requests from the client and sends events back to the client.
